content.text: **Bottom line:** OH gold windows DO have embeddings (158/169 covered), but both probes essentially fail on OH — they predict almost everything as progress, achieving macro-F1 ≈ 0.48. This is due to (a) training only on SWE data and (b) OH having fundamentally different stagnation patterns. The 5 OH stagnation windows in the gold set are too few for reliable evaluation anyway. For the paper, probe results should be reported on SWE-only gold or clearly caveated when including OH.
